definitions.explanation: falling asleep briefly and unintentionally, typically while sitting or doing something else

examples.japanese: ⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧うたた{寝|ね}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I dozed off on the sofa.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧うたた{寝|ね}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{乗|の}り{過|す}ごした→乗り過ごす：07928_norisugosu⟧。
examples.english: I dozed off on the train and missed my stop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧うたた{寝|ね}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I accidentally dozed off during the meeting.

notes:
FORMS:
うたた{寝|ね}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to doze off)

WRITING:
The word can also be written as {転寝|うたたね}, though hiragana is more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{居眠|いねむ}り→居眠り：01822_inemuri⟧ (dozing while sitting, especially at work or in class)
- ひと{眠|ねむ}り (a short nap, intentional)
- ⟦{昼寝|ひるね}→昼寝：00106_hirune⟧ (afternoon nap)

USAGE:
うたた{寝|ね} implies falling asleep unintentionally and briefly, often in a place not meant for sleeping.
